mission: Mechanical verification of SQ-055 wave-2 edits on 10 blog articles. Working from the repo root: (1) run a hugo build (hugo --quiet or hugo -D is NOT wanted — production build, plain `hugo`) and report success/failure with error lines; (2) for the 10 changed files listed in known_facts, extract every /blog/... internal link added in the git diff (git diff HEAD -- <files>) and verify each target resolves to an existing content slug or an alias in frontmatter (write a small python check, quote the command output); (3) verify frontmatter invariants vs git HEAD: title/slug/draft/aliases/sources unchanged, `updated:` == 2026-08-29; (4) check shortcode balance in each changed file: every {{< faq ... >}} has {{< /faq >}}, product-box/amazon tags well-formed; (5) grep changed files for leaked artifacts: 'NEEDS-VERIFICATION', 'TODO', 'PLACEHOLDER', '{{{', unbalanced '{{<' counts; (6) report word-count delta per file. Write the full verification report to .squad/SQ-055/verification-report.md with a PASS/FAIL per check per file. Do NOT modify any content file.
